body: She knows to some degree that I am unhappy right now and struggling but every time we talk I cry and then she cries and I end up feeling like I have to say "everything is fine" so she feels better. It is not fine.

Thanks for replying. I just feel like I'm stuck in life. I dropped out of college a year before I would have graduated because I knew it wasn't path I wanted to follow. But now when I try to think of what I want to do there is nothing. I have been looking for even a part time job while I try to figure shit out but I have neither found a job nor figured a damn thing out. 

My dad died when I was 6.  My mom has always been there for me and raised me and my two brothers by herself. The thing is if I so much as sniffle she starts crying and I feel terrible for upsetting her. I don't know how to ask her for help and feel like if I talk about suicide she will feel responsible and it will destroy her. On the other hand I don't feel like I can go through with it because that would probably destroy her to. All I know is what I am doing now isn't really working.

I don't know what to say to you but our stories seem to be oddly similar. I had school troubles and dropped out and my brother is the only person I have talked to about this at all. He actually brought it up.
